data.one_liner: A slider captcha widget for user authentication and drag-and-drop validation.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable slide captcha widgets (similar to Binance) for client-side or server-side validation. Allows users to drag and drop puzzle pieces or rotate circular images to verify authentication.
use_when: You need a slide captcha widget for user verification.
You want support for both client-side and server-side captcha verification.
avoid_when: You need standard text-based or reCAPTCHA-style validation.
You do not require user-facing captcha widgets.
strengths: Supports both client and server verification workflows.
Offers customization options such as circle mode, custom sizes, and styling.
weaknesses: Changelog entries are minimal and lack detailed feature documentation.
Depends entirely on manual custom setup for server validation endpoints.
